basic_info.description: Welcome to 2940 Turk Blvd - A Beautifully Updated Condo in the Heart of San Francisco    Step into this stunning three-bedroom, two-bathroom home that seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern updates.   Ideally located in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, this residence offers the perfect combination of style, comfort, and convenience.    From the moment you walk in, the home feels just right. Bathed in natural light, the spacious layout features high ceilings, elegant period details, and a thoughtful floor plan with excellent flow. The remodeled kitchen boasts sleek finishes and stainless steel appliances, while both bathrooms have been tastefully updated.     Gorgeous refinished hardwood floors run throughout the home, adding warmth and sophistication.    The serene, meticulously maintained backyardshared with just one other unitfeatures a unique floating'' deck, perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or dining al fresco.    Addition features include a large independent parking spot, tons of storage and private laundry.    This is one of those properties that Checks the Boxes'' and will make the most discerning buyer happy to call home.    Welcome Home.
